title: Fix a Service Selector
prompt:
Service `web-svc` in namespace `cka-sn-selector` has no Endpoints: its selector does not match the Pods of Deployment `web` (labels `app=web`).

Perform the following tasks:
1. Fix Service `web-svc` so it routes traffic to the Pods of Deployment `web`.
2. Do not modify the Deployment or its Pod labels.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-sn-selector
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web-svc
  namespace: cka-sn-selector
spec:
  selector:
    app: webapp
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80

checks.failure_hint: The Service exists — fix its selector.
No endpoints: the selector does not match the Pod labels app=web.
Traffic does not reach the Pods — check the Service selector.

reference_solution:
Fix the Service selector.
```bash
kubectl -n cka-sn-selector patch service web-svc --type=merge -p='{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"web"}}}'
```
hints: Check `k -n cka-sn-selector get endpoints web-svc` and compare with pod labels via `k -n cka-sn-selector get pods --show-labels`.
Align `spec.selector` on Service `web-svc` so it matches the Pod template labels.
